description: Road transport vehicle fleet by type and registration year is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Institut National de la Statistique de Côte d'Ivoire. Vehicle registrations in Côte d'Ivoire 2000-2012. Coverage: Côte d'Ivoire. The portal files it under the publisher Institut National de la Statistique de Côte d'Ivoire. Its tags are vehicle registrations. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
